summary: Structurally valid and every value present is supported, but per-sample age (3/8/12 months), a deposited design variable, is omitted although the declared template union accepts characteristics[age]; WT channels exist only at 8 and 12 months, so without age the genotype contrast is silently confounded.

reviewer_context.context: fresh subagent with no producer transcript; primary evidence re-fetched (PRIDE v3 project + files/all, PRIDE_sample_information.xlsx, Europe PMC fullTextXML PMC11814087, plaque_f001.1.pepXML header, OLS4, MMRRC)

spec_compliance.evidence: 1280 rows x 37 cols, uniform; columns match sdrf-tools contract for ms-proteomics v1.2.0 + vertebrates v1.1.0 + clinical-metadata v1.0.0; (source name, assay name, comment[label]) unique; reserved words only where allowed.

ontology_integrity.evidence: OLS4 resolved all 17 accessions/labels, none obsolete: PRIDE:0000627, MS:1002523, MS:1001251, MS:1000422, PRIDE:0000564/0000608/0000599, UNIMOD:2016/4/35, MS:1000484, BTO:0002774 amyloid plaque, UBERON:0000955, MONDO:0004975, PATO:0000461, EFO:0001272, NCBITaxon:10090. sdrf-tools check: 19/19 verified, 0 UNIMOD swaps.

source_evidence.evidence: Sample->TMTpro channel, genotype and region map matches the 'Plaque proteome' sheet of PRIDE_sample_information.xlsx exactly (16/16). Mods match plaque_f001.1.pepXML (TMTpro K/n-term static, C +57.02146 static, M +15.99492 variable, tryptic). LCM plaque/non-plaque, Lys-C+trypsin, DTT/IAA, HCD 32% NCE, Q Exactive HF confirmed in paper Methods/PRIDE.

file_mapping.evidence: PRIDE files/all (801 files, all projectAccessions=PXD031830): 400 RAW = plaque 80 + mtob1 160 + mtob2 160. Plaque SDRF holds exactly plaque_f001..f080.raw, assay name = file stem, fraction = file index; turnover SDRF holds the other 320; overlap 0, union = all 400 RAW.

design_consistency.evidence: 1 batch x 16 channels x 80 fractions recomputed and correct, but sample sheet age (3/8/12 mo) is not encoded: FAD at 3/8/12 mo, WT only at 8/12 mo, so factor value[genotype] is confounded with age unless age is recorded.

omission_safety.evidence: No unsupported additions found, but material per-sample evidence (Age (mo) column) was omitted on the false premise that no declared template licenses characteristics[age]; a variant adding characteristics[age] 3M/8M/12M validates (exit 0) against the same three templates.

deterministic_validation.evidence: flock ... parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -s <artifact> -t ms-proteomics -t vertebrates -t clinical-metadata --use_ols_cache_only: 'Everything seems to be fine', exit 0 (online-OLS run timed out at 300 s, not completed); sdrf-tools check CLEAN exit 0; score 100/100; structure OK exit 0.

findings.message: Per-sample age (3, 8, 12 months) from the deposited sample sheet is not recorded; it lives only in source names. WT controls exist only at 8 and 12 months, so the genotype factor is confounded with age.
findings.evidence: PRIDE_sample_information.xlsx 'Plaque proteome' column 'Age (mo)'; review-plaque-1/age_variant.tsv with characteristics[age] validates exit 0 under the declared templates; 74 mouse SDRFs in this repo carry characteristics[age].
findings.correction: Add characteristics[age] = 3M/8M/12M per Sample ID (FAD_3m_*=3M, *_8m*=8M, *_12m*=12M), and add factor value[age] (or state why not).

clinical-metadata is declared only to license characteristics[genotype] in a mouse model study; acceptable to the validator but semantically a stretch.
